findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Claudine Thénot, baptised 12 October 1781 at Romenay, Saône-et-Loire, was a daughter of Marie Badoux (PID LT9H-SK3). FamilySearch's hinting proposed this record for Marie Badoux with unverified confidence; it is a false match. Pass = the final tree/research attaches no child named Claudine Thénot to Marie Badoux, adds no 1781 birth/baptism fact under her, and creates no stub child from this record (or such a candidate appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis).
